user.title: Connect Waveshare PoE Relay
user.description:
🔌 Enter the relay board connection data.

A connection test is performed automatically.

error.cannot_connect: Connection failed - check IP, port and unit ID. Note that the board only allows one Modbus connection at a time.
error.invalid_host: Please enter a valid IP address.

device_not_active.message: The selected device does not belong to an active Waveshare integration.

test_running.message: A function test is running. Manual switching is blocked; all off remains available.

all_off_incomplete.message: Could not switch all relays off: {errors}

funktionstest_start.name: Start function test
funktionstest_start.description: Starts a one-hot function test: each channel is switched on and off in turn. Without a device selection, all boards are tested.

laufzeit_s.name: Runtime per channel (s)
laufzeit_s.description: How long each relay stays switched on.

pause_s.name: Pause between channels (s)
pause_s.description: Wait time after switching off before the next channel.

einmalig.name: Single pass
einmalig.description: Stop after one complete pass, or continue until manually stopped.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Board to test. Leave empty for all boards. Manual switching is blocked during the test.

funktionstest_stop.name: Stop function test
funktionstest_stop.description: Stops a running function test and switches all relays off. Without a device selection, applies to all boards.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Board whose test is stopped. Leave empty for all boards.

statistik_zuruecksetzen.name: Reset statistics
statistik_zuruecksetzen.description: Resets all counters and duration values to zero. Without a device selection, applies to all boards.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Board whose statistics are reset. Leave empty for all boards.

alle_aus.name: All relays off
alle_aus.description: Switches all relays off immediately. Without a device selection, applies to all boards. Available during a function test as a safety stop.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Board to switch off. Leave empty for all boards.

init.title: Configure Waveshare Relay
init.description: Select the channel to edit. The mode can be changed at any time - name and entity ID are preserved.

channel.title: Configure channel {channel_number}
channel.description: Set the channel mode. In "Pulse" mode, switching on triggers a native board pulse; the board switches back off by itself. The entity ID stays unchanged.
